snippet.title: Deep Dish Dungeon | Launch Trailer | Available Now
snippet.description:
Developed by the creators of beloved indie games Knights of Pen & Paper and Chroma Squad, Deep Dish Dungeon is a dungeon crawler and exploration game that rewards curiosity and resourcefulness in an atmospheric environment. Explore corridors, rooms and passageways solo or with up to two friends, and gather resources to improve your campsite. Craft tools and cook nourishing meals to bolster your strength throughout the journey, and unravel the enigma that lies within the shadows.

Deep Dish Dungeon is now available on Steam, Xbox Game Pass as a day one title, XBOX on PC, XBOX Series X|S, and XBOX Cloud. Also, Steam Deck verified, XBOX handheld verified and supported on XBOX Play Anywhere!
